newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kellogg EPS estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kellogg EPS estimates cut.

text.p: -- Goldman, Sachs analyst Nomi Ghez said Friday she reduced her earnings estimates for Kellogg Co by $0.05 to $3.10 for 1996 and by $0.20 to $3.45 for 1997.
-- Ghez said her estimate for the fourth quarter remains $0.81 a share, up from $0.77 a year ago. The analyst said she does not have a "high level of confidence" in the fourth quarter estimate.
-- Earlier, Kellogg reported third quarter earnings of $0.75 a share, after $0.10 in earnings, down from $1.05 a year ago.
-- Kellogg said its third quarter performance was influenced significantly by competition conditions in the U.S. cereal category.
